description: Phase 21R-A: Citrus Refer & Earn referral capture, transactional outbox and signed delivery. Servana is a SOURCE PRODUCT (ADR-013): it captures the referral at merchant self-registration, keeps an immutable local snapshot so a referrer's claim survives R&E being unavailable, emits its own merchant lifecycle facts through a transactional outbox, signs delivery per the X-Citrus-* contract, and records every attempt. Three additive tables: referral_snapshots (one per merchant; raw code encrypted; allowlisted non-PII landing metadata; NO referrer identity column of any kind; terminal-status + capture-evidence immutability trigger); re_outbound_events (append-only outbox inserted in the SAME transaction as its source fact; ULID event_id stable across retries; content_sha256 over canonical JSON; per-merchant monotonic sequence_no; event_type CHECK admitting ONLY the five 21R-A merchant.* types); re_event_deliveries (append-only attempt history; response body redacted then bounded to 512 chars). Capture runs inside the registration transaction in a SAVEPOINT so registration is NEVER blocked or failed by R&E (Plan A-19); malformed codes are stored as invalid_format evidence and are NEVER sent to R&E; unreferred, invalid_format and rejected merchants stream NOTHING (the §58B.1 data-minimization boundary). Signing is algorithm-aware and FAILS CLOSED (ADR-015: no hardcoded HMAC-SHA-256). R&E-owned capability - referrer accounts, referral codes as system of record, campaigns, reward rules, reward calculation, reward ledger, referrer payouts, reward statements - is NOT built. Phase 21R-B (subscription.*/activity.* events, qualification engine, inbound reconciliation surface, re_activity_rule_versions / re_qualification_periods / re_qualification_decisions / re_inbound_requests) is NOT built and is blocked behind 20D-W / External Gate W (CLOSED).

description: Phase 21S: Personnel bulk SMS to PERSONALLY SERVED clients only, with contact protection as the phase-defining invariant (ADR-010; Plan §19.4 non-overridable "Personnel can never gain contact export"). A Personnel member may message only clients for whom THEIR OWN staff profile completed at least one service session in the acting merchant + branch; staff_profile_id is derived from the authenticated membership and is never accepted from the request. Four additive branch-owned/EXEMPT tables: personnel_sms_campaigns (own-scope campaign; encrypted message body; composition/pricing snapshot frozen past draft; terminal statuses trigger-enforced), personnel_sms_recipients (immutable per-recipient snapshot; phone_encrypted NULLABLE so a suppressed/opted-out recipient never has their number copied at all; phone_last_four is the maximum display identifier; jsonb CHECK forbids a phone key; append-only, never deleted), sms_delivery_attempts (append-only provider attempts; result_class stores the retry decision input; redaction CHECK rejects any 7+ digit run), sms_billing_entries (amount_minor = quantity * unit_cost_minor CHECK; partial unique index permits ONE live entry per campaign = structural no-double-billing). Preview is advisory and creates/sends/bills nothing; confirm re-runs the SAME evaluator, suppresses recipients that no longer qualify, refuses entirely when none survive, re-prices from the survivors, snapshots consent, creates the single provisional charge, and queues delivery only AFTER COMMIT. Duplicate confirm sends once three ways over (Idempotency-Key replay, domain no-op, DB partial unique index). Delivery goes through a provider ADAPTER: the deterministic fake is bound whenever the integration is disabled/unconfigured and unconditionally in testing, so CI can never reach a live provider; the HTTP client fails closed on any missing credential. Transient failures retry with capped backoff then dead-letter at HIGH severity; invalid-recipient and provider opt-out are PERMANENT and never retried. Servana MOVES NO MONEY (ADR-012): sms_billing_entries is a liability queue, and the nullable FK to subscription_invoice_items is the seam a future billing phase sets. Phase 21S also ships the minimal Plan §20 entitlement RUNTIME that 20A/20B left unbound (SubscriptionPlanContextResolver + EnsureEntitlement), because personnel.my_sms.send is the first entitlement-gated permission and the sms entitlement could never have resolved without it.

description: Phase 22: tenant/branch-scoped, permission-aware search. GET /api/v1/search is an AGGREGATOR, not a data authority (decision D-22-01): it grants access to nothing, and a document type is admitted only after the server proves the caller already holds the authority governing that type's own list/detail route. NO permission key is added - the live matrix has 130 active / 38 planned keys and none is owned by Phase 22, no search.* key exists anywhere, and front_office.search was NOT broadened. A caller with no searchable authority receives 200 + an empty collection, never 403, so zero results and no authority are indistinguishable (no existence oracle over the catalogue). Three independent layers must agree before a row is returned: the ENGINE filter (merchant_id = X AND branch_id IN [..], built server-side from integers only), the SQL re-resolution through the model's tenant-scoped query with BelongsToMerchant/BelongsToBranch still applied, and a per-record Gate::allows('view') that is the SAME policy call the record's own detail route makes - so security never depends on Meilisearch being correctly filtered (proven by a deliberately POISONED index). Launch catalogue: client, staff, appointment, queue_entry, service_session, invoice, receipt (Meilisearch-indexed) plus served_client (Personnel own-scope, PostgreSQL ONLY via the Phase 21S ServedClientSelector, never indexed - D-22-06). The index holds ONLY id + merchant_id + branch_id + allowlisted match text; every displayed value is read from PostgreSQL, displayedAttributes is id, and sortableAttributes is empty everywhere so no caller token can reach an engine sort. CONTACT PROTECTION (D-22-03): the response schema has NO contact field of any kind - no phone, phone_masked, phone_last_four, email or email_masked - even for the types whose own Resources return masked contact today; no phone/email/phone_index/blind-index/StaffProfile.phone value is indexed; operator free text (notes, *_reason) is excluded. Authorized EXACT phone lookup exists for Front Office through the existing keyed HMAC blind index, requires client.view AND front_office.search, returns the client NAME only, NEVER reaches Meilisearch, and is redacted out of meta.query; a partial phone fragment is not searchable anywhere. Integration payload tables are never indexed (referral_snapshots, re_outbound_events, re_event_deliveries, SMS recipient/attempt/billing tables, audit tables, payment tables, future wallet_* tables). Deferred with reasons: service (no SPA detail screen), payments/refunds/cash-ups/finance disputes+exports, compensation/payouts/earnings, audit logs, SMS campaigns, platform-side merchants/branches, client consents.
